about: Hand labels of round-1 engineer items on the corpus fixtures (docs/fixtures/corpus.json; ADR-0002, twenty-third measurement), judged against each fixture's post_rev by the rules and notes of eval_harness/corpus_labels.json. Keys: #n stored blocker, #hn hedge-demoted blocker (the end of the concerns), #cn concern, #qn question, numbered as eval_harness.corpus score lists them. Every blocker and hedge-demoted blocker is labeled; a concern or question is labeled only when it states a known bug's defect, so an unlabeled one counts as no known bug. Written before either arm is scored.

classes.unlisted: valid but minor: a change the same fix commit reverted, not a functional bug
classes.invariant-elsewhere: false: a removed or missing check whose invariant another function enforces in the post-state
classes.thread-confusion: false: a race claimed on state only one thread touches, or that is set before the worker starts
classes.bounds-fixed-array: false: an out-of-bounds claim on a fixed-size, zero-initialized array
classes.deletion: false: removed code or a removed comment presented as current
classes.other-fp: false: any other claim the post-state refutes
